name: cedarloom
description: CedarLoom: the cl-workflow, cl-setup and cl-orchestration plugins for Claude Code and Codex, the cl-orca runner plugin for Claude Code, and the cedarloom bundle that installs all four.

plugins.name: cedarloom
plugins.description: Installs the CedarLoom plugins cl-workflow, cl-setup, cl-orchestration and cl-orca together.

plugins.name: cl-workflow
plugins.description: Chooses how much checking a task gets (a software change, a docs pass or research) and starts the planning, review and research agents it needs.

plugins.name: cl-setup
plugins.description: Sets up and maintains projects: agent instructions and dev container per repository, a maintenance pass and a review of the rules files.

plugins.name: cl-orchestration
plugins.description: Coordinates the issues of several projects from one session: worker jobs, reviews and merge checks. Installs cl-workflow with it.

plugins.name: cl-orca
plugins.description: Runs the workers of the cl-orchestration coordinator in Orca terminals, one worktree each. Installs cl-orchestration with it.
